offering_description.value: Silvercrest manages investments for wealthy individuals, families and institutional investors. It invests through separately managed accounts and pooled funds and provides family office services to private clients.

primary_services.value: Discretionary portfolio management; investment advisory; financial planning; family office administration

customer_segment.value: B2C: High-net-worth individuals and families; B2B: Endowments, foundations and other institutional investors

end_markets.value: Private wealth management; institutional investment management

revenue_model.value: commissions or management fees: Asset-based fees for managing portfolios and funds, plus performance fees on certain mandates; service fees: Family office administration and reporting
revenue_model.category: commissions or management fees; service fees

value_chain_position.value: service provider: Uses client objectives and financial records to manage portfolios and provide family office services; financial intermediary: Pools capital from eligible investors and invests it on their behalf

geography_served.value: US national: Serves clients across the United States from offices in markets including New York and Boston

specialization.value: related lines: Private wealth management, institutional investment management and family office services

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Advisory teams that work directly with private clients and institutional investors

regulatory_exposure.value: high: Investment advisory through SEC-registered advisers subject to the Investment Advisers Act and fiduciary obligations

notes: The extent of any current operations outside the United States is uncertain.
